title: Separate release admission from publication execution
body:
## Source and architectural split

PR #7 at `194512b4ce7e9e706f555a4f933449c632bb8fb5` contains useful release/target vocabulary inside `src/fork_tales/law/studio.cljc`, but that file also owns content-editing objects. Preserve the vocabulary on current main `43963c84b612c896cb383bffa5e7d58e32211472` without making content generation, arrangement/layout, product review, and publishing one domain.

Depends on #9 for immutable studio artifacts. This card owns the explicit seam after an export exists.

## Boundary

- **Studio/content law** produces work/render/clip/arrangement/export artifacts and provenance.
- **Product review/release admission** records a human-scoped acceptance decision over exact artifact versions.
- **Publication law** plans independently target-specific attempts.
- **Publication adapters** authenticate, upload, poll, and record external results.

A successful export is not an accepted release. An accepted release is not a published target. One target’s state cannot promote another target.

## Scope

- canonical release identity and exact admitted artifact versions/hashes;
- rights/credits/artwork facts required for release admission;
- immutable product-review decision/receipt with reviewer and rubric/version;
- target capability declarations;
- per-target publication plans, attempts, checkpoints, and results;
- manual-handoff/unavailable outcomes;
- retry/idempotency/conflict semantics.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Release admission fails if any artifact hash/version, rights basis, required credit, or required review receipt is absent/stale.
- [ ] Retry with the same receipt/attempt identity is idempotent only for a completely equal canonical payload; any difference conflicts.
- [ ] Target A state cannot mutate or satisfy Target B.
- [ ] Publication state records contain no credentials or refresh tokens.
- [ ] Effects occur only behind target adapters; pure laws operate on data.
- [ ] Failed/unavailable/manual-action outcomes preserve prior evidence and a resumable checkpoint without claiming publication.
- [ ] Provider callbacks/polls correlate to exact attempt and artifact identities.
- [ ] Product-review semantics remain distinct from translation SME evaluation; shared receipt primitives are explicit contracts, not shared workflow ownership.

## Required proof

- [ ] Pure unit/property tests cover admission failure, stale evidence, cross-target isolation, complete-payload retry conflicts, and no-credential schemas.
- [ ] Fake target adapter integration covers success, timeout, retry, manual handoff, and callback mismatch.
- [ ] One E2E fixture traces immutable export → product-review receipt → release admission → target plan without live credentials.
- [ ] Hosted `clojure -M:test`, zero-warning lint, and coverage pass.
- [ ] Receipt River pins immutable SHA and distinguishes hermetic proof from any later live-provider smoke.

## Non-goals

No clip editing, arrangement UI, audio rendering, translation generation, translation SME review, provider credentials, or live upload in the merge gate.
